```{r config,include=FALSE}
library(here)
library(knitr)
library(qrcode)

source(here::here("presentation", "helpers.R"))

# The repository name

message(Sys.getenv("GITHUB_REPOSITORY"))

# Process the repository name to generate the URL
# - split the two components
# - combine them into a URL with 'github.io' in the middle

SUBDIRECTORY <- "" # Leave this empty if this file is in the main directory of the repository

GITHUB_REPOSITORY <- Sys.getenv("GITHUB_REPOSITORY")
if (GITHUB_REPOSITORY == "") GITHUB_REPOSITORY <- "larsvilhuber/reproducible-documents"
GITHUB_REPOSITORY_PARTS <- strsplit(GITHUB_REPOSITORY, "/")[[1]]
REPOSITORY_URL <- paste0("https://github.com/", GITHUB_REPOSITORY)
EXAMPLES_URL <- paste0(REPOSITORY_URL, "/tree/main/examples/")

WEBSITE_URL <- paste0("https://", GITHUB_REPOSITORY_PARTS[1], ".github.io/", GITHUB_REPOSITORY_PARTS[2], "/", SUBDIRECTORY)
WEBSITE_SHORT <- paste0(GITHUB_REPOSITORY_PARTS[1], ".github.io/", GITHUB_REPOSITORY_PARTS[2], "/", SUBDIRECTORY)

# The notebook used in part 4
COLAB_REPOSITORY_URL <- "https://github.com/larsvilhuber/jupyter-stata-colab"
COLAB_URL <- "https://colab.research.google.com/github/larsvilhuber/jupyter-stata-colab/blob/main/stata_colab_example.ipynb"
BINDER_URL <- "https://mybinder.org/v2/gh/larsvilhuber/jupyter-stata-colab/HEAD?urlpath=%2Fdoc%2Ftree%2Fstata_colab_example.ipynb"
COLAB_SOLUTIONS_URL <- "https://colab.research.google.com/github/larsvilhuber/jupyter-stata-colab/blob/main/stata_colab_solutions.ipynb"

# Numbers quoted on the slides are computed, not typed: same data and
# regression as in all four examples (OLS, so identical to Stata's regress)
auto <- haven::read_dta("https://www.stata-press.com/data/r19/auto.dta")
AUTO_N <- nrow(auto)
AUTO_COEF_MPG <- sprintf("%.1f", coef(lm(price ~ mpg + weight, data = auto))["mpg"])

# QR code pointing to the website
qrcode::generate_svg(qrcode::qr_code(WEBSITE_URL),
                     filename = here::here("presentation", "qrcode.svg"),
                     show = FALSE)
```
